content:
Back in May, we wrote about the Procolored X One 3-in-1 laser engraver with UV and UV-DTF color printing, and the company contacted us a few months later for a review. But instead of having us review the laser engraver, they proposed that we test their K13 Lite DTF printer “developed for small businesses and creators producing customized apparel and merchandise”. Basically, a T-shirt printer using DTF (Direct-to-Film) technology. I wasn’t so sure at first, since T-shirt and garment printing isn’t exactly one of the primary topics we cover here at CNX Software! But I eventually decided to go ahead, since it might be interesting to understand the setup process, workflow, software, print quality/durability, and maintenance requirements for such a machine.
